question: What is the meaning of contextual information in relation to object characteristics (objective registered data related to circularity)?
data_group: object characteristics (objective registered data related to circularity)
description: The contextual information in relation to object characteristics refers to the registered data linked to the life cycle of products. This data encompasses various types of life cycle registrations, not limited to environmental aspects, and includes information about smaller objects that can be part of larger objects through replacement or circulation. The data at the small object level can be externally governed but linked for use in larger objects, serving as an interface to multiple components and their individual life cycle histories. The ultimate goal is to provide insight into sustainability, circularity characteristics, circular value estimation, and circular opportunities, aiding in understanding product sustainability, identifying circular value components, and suggesting circular strategies for specific products.
